title: Pure Amazoness
summary: Amazoness cards with the Polymerization they search, plus generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Amazoness is an EARTH Warrior battle and Fusion deck where Princess and War Chief assemble Fusions that protect your entire board and swarm during the Battle Phase.

summary.title: Starters
points: Amazoness Call searches any Amazoness card from the Deck or sends it to the GY, and banishes itself from the GY to let an Amazoness monster attack all opposing monsters.

Amazoness Princess counts as Amazoness Queen on the field or in the GY, searches an Amazoness Spell/Trap on summon, and sends another card from your hand or field to the GY when declaring an attack to Special Summon an Amazoness from the Deck.

Amazoness War Chief Special Summons itself if you control no monsters or only Amazoness monsters, then Sets an Amazoness Spell/Trap or Polymerization directly from the Deck (locking you into Amazoness attacks for the turn).

Amazoness Spiritualist returns another Amazoness card you control to the hand to Special Summon itself from the hand or GY, and searches Polymerization on Special Summon (locking the Extra Deck to Amazoness monsters that turn).

summary.title: Opening: Amazoness Princess + War Chief
steps: Normal Summon Amazoness Princess to search Amazoness Call, which searches Amazoness Spiritualist or a Pendulum Scale.
Special Summon Amazoness War Chief from the hand to Set Amazoness Secret Arts from the Deck, then bounce War Chief with Spiritualist to Special Summon Spiritualist and search Polymerization.

Fuse into Amazoness Empress or Amazoness Pet Liger with Polymerization, then use Amazoness Secret Arts (or banish Secret Arts from the GY so one Fusion substitutes for a required Fusion Monster material) to Fusion Summon Amazoness Augusta.

summary.title: Pendulum Scales: Whip & Sword
summary.text: Amazoness Golden Whip Master (Scale 1) and Amazoness Silver Sword Master (Scale 7) give all your Amazoness monsters 100 ATK per Level in the Pendulum Zone and place themselves in your Scales whenever they are destroyed on the field. Whenever an Amazoness monster battles, Golden Whip Master destroys a Spell/Trap on the field and Silver Sword Master recovers an Amazoness Continuous Spell/Trap or Fusion Spell from your GY.

summary.title: Fusion Bosses & Battle Control
points: Amazoness Augusta (Level 10) prevents the opponent from targeting or destroying your other Amazoness cards with effects, Special Summons an Amazoness from the Deck when Fusion Summoned, and attacks twice if made with Amazoness Empress or Queen.
Amazoness Empress (Level 8) grants piercing damage and battle/effect destruction protection to your other Amazoness cards, and floats into Amazoness Queen when it leaves the field.
Amazoness Pet Liger King (Level 9) prevents the opponent from attacking anything except itself and destroys an Amazoness card you control to revive an Amazoness Warrior from the GY.

summary.title: Spells, Traps & Locks
points: Amazoness Secret Arts is a Quick-Play Fusion Spell that can also be banished from the GY before Fusion Summoning to let an Amazoness Fusion in your Extra Deck count as a named Fusion material.
Amazoness Hot Spring and Amazoness Hall place or recover Pendulums and gain LP when you take battle damage, while Amazoness Village floats into a new Amazoness whenever one is destroyed.
Amazoness Spiritualist restricts Extra Deck summons to Amazoness monsters for the turn, so use generic Rank 4s or Links only on turns you do not activate Spiritualist.

allow.Polymerization: Amazoness Spiritualist and Amazoness War Chief search or Set it.
